areas.name: Quantum Computing
anchors: Quantum computing: building and operating qubit processors that run quantum algorithms, including superconducting circuits, trapped ions, spin qubits and photonic processors.
Design, control and readout of qubits; two-qubit gates, gate fidelity, decoherence and coherence times, quantum error correction and fault-tolerant logical qubits.

Quantum algorithms and their simulation: variational algorithms, quantum simulation of many-body systems, quantum advantage and supremacy demonstrations, compilation and benchmarking of quantum circuits.
Terminology: qubit, transmon, quantum gate, quantum circuit, quantum processor, surface code, NISQ device, quantum annealing, quantum volume.

areas.name: Quantum Communication
anchors: Quantum communication and cryptography: distributing quantum states over optical fibre, free space and satellite links to transmit information securely.
Quantum key distribution protocols, entanglement distribution, quantum repeaters and quantum memories, teleportation, and the quantum internet.
Security of quantum cryptographic protocols, device-independent and measurement-device-independent schemes, secret key rates, single-photon sources and detectors for quantum links.
Terminology: QKD, BB84, entanglement swapping, Bell inequality violation, quantum channel capacity, quantum network node, decoy states.

areas.name: Quantum Sensing and Metrology
anchors: Quantum sensing and metrology: exploiting quantum coherence, entanglement and squeezing to measure physical quantities more precisely than classical limits allow.
Precision measurement of magnetic and electric fields, time, frequency, gravity and rotation using atomic clocks, atom interferometers, NV centres in diamond, SQUIDs and optomechanical resonators.

Quantum-enhanced measurement theory and practice: the standard quantum limit, Heisenberg limit, quantum Fisher information, squeezed light injection, noise and back-action in quantum-limited detection.
Terminology: magnetometry, atomic clock, atom interferometer, NV centre, SQUID, squeezed state, quantum limit, sensitivity, calibration standard.
